Name: (FF) Minakie's Custom Furniture
Author: CyanFire
Description:
Furniture Framework conversion of Minakie's Custom Furniture, with permission from Minakie to share this you all!


Most furniture is purchaseable on Wednesday's at Robin's, the pet furniture is purchaseable on Thursday's at Marnie's.
It is all available via the Furniture Catalogue too

Variants of certain furniture items are available by rotating those particular items such as the pet bowls, pet beds, cat scratching post/cat tree, doghouse, non-animated tip jar, piggy bank & coffers.


[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/35985545]Minakie[/url]'s Original Custom Furniture mod: https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5072
